start: Any screen except the live workout, round chat button on the screen edge, online, no unread reply

steps.action: Tap the round chat button on the screen edge
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Help and feedback'
'Ask about this screen and get an answer at once, or tell us what is wrong here.'
Box with 'Type here, or tap Speak'
Send button greyed out
must_not: The sheet opens on someone else's questions
Send can be tapped with an empty box

steps.action: Type a question about the screen
user_sees: The typed words in the box
Send turns on
must_not: Typing past 2,000 letters
The round button floating over the keyboard

steps.action: Tap Send
user_sees: Send shows it is busy
'Sending. The answer usually takes a few seconds.'
Then 'Thanks! We read every message.' or a Quick answer card
'Your questions and answers are kept in Profile → Settings → Help and feedback.'
must_not: The message sent twice
The box emptied before the send went through
A success line when the send failed

start: Live workout screen open, sets being ticked

steps.action: Tap the chat button in the workout's top bar (next to Minimise)
user_sees: The same 'Help and feedback' sheet
The workout still running under it
must_not: The workout or its rest timer stopping
A round floating button covering the set ticks or Finish

steps.action: Type a message and tap Send, then close the sheet
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.'
Back on the live workout with every set as it was
must_not: A set or the timer lost
The message tagged with a screen name that holds an id or a code

start: Help and feedback sheet open from the round button

steps.action: Leave the box empty, or type only spaces
user_sees: Send stays greyed out
must_not: An empty message sent
An error pop-up

steps.action: Turn the internet off, type a message and tap Send
user_sees: 'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here.' in red
The typed message still in the box
must_not: The message lost
'Thanks! We read every message.'
The question left in 'Your questions' as waiting for ever

steps.action: Switch the round button off in Settings → 'Help and feedback' and go back to a screen
user_sees: No round button on the screen edge
The workout top-bar chat button still there
must_not: The round button still showing with no unread reply
The top-bar button gone too

start: Sheet open, a message half typed, then closed

steps.action: Close the sheet and open it again from the round button
user_sees: The half-typed message still in the box
No old 'Thanks!' line
must_not: The typed message lost
The last answer or error still showing as if new

steps.action: Send it; once 'Thanks! We read every message.' shows, start typing again
user_sees: The thanks line goes as soon as typing starts
'See your questions and answers' button
must_not: The thanks line staying over the new message
The sent message still in the box

steps.action: Drag the round button up the edge and let go, close and reopen the app
user_sees: The button stays where it was dropped, half behind the edge
must_not: The button jumping back to its old spot
A drag that opens the sheet

start: Help and feedback sheet open on the Members list or an exercise page

steps.action: Type a question and tap Send
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.' or a Quick answer
must_not: The screen name sent with an exercise id, a member id or a join code in it
The member's name or mobile number sent when not typed
The message reaching the gym's owner or trainers
